newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar production levies to stay same.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar production levies to stay same.

text.p: European Union 1996/97 sugar production levies are to remain unchanged from last year the sugar management committee decided on Wednesday, an EU member state official said on Thursday.
The basic advance levies for A and B quota sugar were set at 0.632 Ecus per 100 kg. The additional B quota levy was set at 11.848 Ecus per 100 kg.
The isoglucose A and B quota levies were set at 0.506 Ecus per 100 kg of dry matter. No additonal B quota levy was set.
The inulin syrup A and B quota basic levies were set at 0.632 Ecus per 100 kg of dry matter equivalent. The additional B quota levy was set at 11.848 Ecus per 100 kg of dry matter equivalent.
"The levies were set at the same rates as last year and there will be a review in September," the official said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
